name: Server Reload Dep
brief: Dependency app: defines the table a later bundle reload extends.
description: Cross-request half of server-reload (issue #1860). Defines a plain table with no tableextension of its own. A --server session's FIRST runTests request loads only this app, resolving the table's base Record CLR type and recording it in _fieldTriggersWiredTables before any tableextension for it exists. A SECOND runTests request in the SAME session then loads this app again alongside server-reload-main, which adds a tableextension with a field OnValidate trigger — the exact interleaving the wired-tables guard does not account for.
